faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DHS Tiruvallur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DHS Tiruvallur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 Psychologist, 1 Occupational Therapists, 2 Radiographer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DHS Tiruvallur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Tiruvallur district website tiruvallur.nic.in) and send it to Member Secretary / District Health Officer, District Health Society, District Health Office, 54/5, Aasoori Street, Tiruvallur District, by in person or speed post, to reach by 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 27,000 for Psychologist, 27,000 for Occupational Therapists, 17,000 for Radiographer.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Psychologist: M.A or M.Sc in Psychology / Applied / Clinical / Counseling Psychology or five-year integrated M.Sc in clinical psychology, with Tamil and English; Occupational Therapists: Bachelors/Master's degree in Occupational Therapy; Radiographer: As per MRB Norms B.Sc Radiography. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Psychologist: ability to speak, read and write Tamil and English.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications received after 18.11.2026 5.00 PM will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Posts are on temporary contract basis at consolidated pay. The post is purely temporary. Will not be made permanent at any time.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tiruvallur district.
